title: Illumina Library Construction for Extraction Methods A, B, C, D, E
author: Faezah Mohd Salleh
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ingcdbw

steps.title: End-repair and heat inactivate
steps.instruction: Perform end‑repair using T4 PNK (phosphorylase kinase) and T4 DNA polymerase as described by Fortes & Paijmans 2015, then heat‑inactivate the enzymes to eliminate the need for column clean‑up.

steps.title: Ligate Illumina adapters
steps.instruction: Ligate Illumina P5 and P7 adapters to the end‑repaired DNA using a final adapter concentration of 0.5 µM (adapter mix prepared from 20 µM each P5 and P7) following Fortes & Paijmans 2015.

steps.title: Purify ligated library
steps.instruction: Purify the adapter‑ligated library using Qiagen MinElute columns according to the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Elute ligated library
steps.instruction: Elute the purified library in 20 µL of Buffer EB (Qiagen).

steps.title: Fill in adapter overhangs
steps.instruction: Perform the fill‑in reaction of the ligated adapters prior to indexing, following Fortes & Paijmans 2015.

steps.title: Indexing PCR (first round)
steps.instruction: Set up a 15 µL PCR using AmpliTaq Gold (Applied Biosystems), Primer IS4 and the appropriate individual indexing primer; run no more than 10 cycles as per Fortes & Paijmans 2015.

substeps.instruction: If necessary, run parallel amplifications for each sample with a corrected (lower) number of cycles to avoid over‑amplification and increased read clonality.

steps.title: Assess library on Tapestation
steps.instruction: Run the indexed libraries on an Agilent Tapestation HS to estimate fragment‑size distribution and determine molar concentration.

steps.title: Purify indexed library
steps.instruction: Purify the indexed PCR products using Qiagen MinElute columns.

steps.title: Elute final library
steps.instruction: Elute the purified indexed library in 20 µL of Buffer EB.
